mapper.delete: DELETE a FROM cut_cutover_support_arrangement a JOIN cut_plan_revision p ON p.id = a.plan_revision_id AND p.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND a.plan_revision_id = #{query.planRevisionId} AND p.status_code = 'DRAFT' AND p.current_marker = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cut_cutover_support_arrangement SET person_name = #{query.personName}, phone = #{query.phone}, arrival_time = #{query.arrivalTime}, updater = #{query.updater}, update_time = #{query.updateTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND id = #{query.arrangementId} AND plan_revision_id = #{query.planRevisionId} AND version = #{query.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
